work.author: Frank Edward Brightman
work.description: Brightman's two-volume synopsis, printing the Latin and English sources of the Book of Common Prayer in parallel columns headed Sources, 1549, 1552 and 1661. Volume II carries the Communion service and the collects, epistles and gospels through the year; volume I the Calendar, the daily offices and the Litany.
work.title: The English Rite: being a synopsis of the sources and revisions of the Book of Common Prayer
